simple.meaning: יְהוֹשׁוּעַ (Yᵉhôwshûwaʻ) appears 218 times in the Hebrew Scriptures as a person-name in the Hebrew text.
simple.biblicalBackground: The first appearances are in Exodus, Numbers, Deuteronomy, Joshua, beginning at Exodus 17:9. BibleIQ detects the main surrounding context as family line, mountain.

definitions.full: H3091. Yehoshua יְהוֺשֻׁעַ יְהוֺשׁוּעַ, and (later) יֵשׁוּעַ , proper name, masculine (& location, see 9 below) ( ׳י is salvation , or ׳י is opulence , compare אֲבִישׁוּעַ אֱלִישׁוּעַ, אֱלִישָׁע, & Nes SK 1892, 573 f. ; in any case it came to be associated with ישׁע , compare Matt 1:21 ; on יֵשׁוּעַ see especially Frä VOJ iv. 1890, 332 f. Müll SK 1892, 177 f. who cite analogue for change of ֹו to later ֵ֯ , & Nes l.c .) — 1 Moses' successor, son of Nun, ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς ) יְהוֺשׁוּעַ Deut 3:21 ; Judg 2:7 ; = יְהוֺשֻׁעַ Exod 17:9-10 , 13 , 14 ; 24:13 ; 32:17 ; 33:11 ; Num 11:28 ; 13:16 ; 14:6 , 30 , 38 ; 26:65 ; 27:18 , 22 ; 32:12 , 28 ; 34:17 ; Deut 1:38 ; 3:28 ; 31:3 , 7 , 14 (twice in verse); 31:23 ; 34:9 ; Josh 1:1 167t. Joshua; Judg 1:1 ; 2:6-7 , 8 , 21 , 23 ; 1Kin 16:34 ; 1Chr 7:27 ; = יֵשׁוּעַ Neh 8:17 ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς ); according to P, name changed by Moses from הוֺשֵׁעַ q. v. Num 13:8 , 16 ( ᵐ5 Αὑση ) Deut 32:44 ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς ). 2 יְהוֺשֻׁעַ a Bethshemite 1Sam 6:14 , 18 ( ᵐ5 'Wshe , A Ἰησοῦς , ᵐ5 L Ἰωσηε ). 3 high priest after the restoration, son of Jehozadak יְהוֺשֻׁעַ ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς ) Hag 1:1 , 12 , 14 ; 2:2 , 4 ; Zech 3:1 , 3 , 6 , 8 , 9 ; 6:11 ; = יְשׁוּעַ ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς ) Ezra 2:2 ; 3:2 , 8 ; 4:3 ; 5:2 ; 10:18 ; Neh 7:7 ; 12:1 , 7 , 10 , 26 . 4 יְהוֺשֻׁעַ governor of Jerusalem under Josiah 2Kin 23:8 ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς , ᵐ5 L Ἰωσηε ). 5 יֵשׁוּעַ ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς ). head of one of the classes of priests 1Chr 24:11 , possibly also Ezra 2:36 = Neh 7:39 . 6 יֵשׁוּעַ ( ᵐ5 Ἰησοῦς etc.), a Levitical family-name of frequent occurrence: a. Ezra 2:40 ; 3:9 = Neh 7:43 ; 8:7 ; 9:4-5 , 10:10 ; 12:8 . b. 2Chr 31:15 ; Ezra 8:33 ; Neh 12:24 . 7 יֵשׁוּעַ ( ᵐ5 id. ), father of a builder at the wall Neh 3:19 , perhaps = 8 a Judaite family-name ( ᵐ5 id. ), Ezra 2:6 = Neh 7:11 (compare Sm Listen 12 ). 9. proper name, of a location in south of Judah Neh 11:26 בְּיֵשׁוּעַ ( ᵐ5 ἐν Ἰησού , ᵐ5 L ἐν Σουα ). יֵשׁוּעַ יְהוֺשֻׁעַ, proper name .

occurrences.englishText: Moses said to Joshua, “Choose men for us, and go out, fight with Amalek. Tomorrow I will stand on the top of the hill with God’s rod in my hand.”
So Joshua did as Moses had told him, and fought with Amalek; and Moses, Aaron, and Hur went up to the top of the hill.
Joshua defeated Amalek and his people with the edge of the sword.
Yahweh said to Moses, “Write this for a memorial in a book, and rehearse it in the ears of Joshua: that I will utterly blot out the memory of Amalek from under the sky.”
Moses rose up with Joshua, his servant, and Moses went up onto God’s Mountain.
When Joshua heard the noise of the people as they shouted, he said to Moses, “There is the noise of war in the camp.”
Yahweh spoke to Moses face to face, as a man speaks to his friend. He turned again into the camp, but his servant Joshua, the son of Nun, a young man, didn’t depart from the Tent.
Joshua the son of Nun, the servant of Moses, one of his chosen men, answered, “My lord Moses, forbid them!”
These are the names of the men who Moses sent to spy out the land. Moses called Hoshea the son of Nun Joshua.
Joshua the son of Nun and Caleb the son of Jephunneh, who were of those who spied out the land, tore their clothes.
surely you shall not come into the land concerning which I swore that I would make you dwell therein, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.

For Yahweh had said of them, “They shall surely die in the wilderness.” There was not a man left of them, except Caleb the son of Jephunneh, and Joshua the son of Nun.
